description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“HP 45W What the Heck,” at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach. Waking up to endless Gulf views, breezy high ceilings, and a space that just feels like vacation. Spend your days lounging by a resort pool, sipping cocktails at Crabby Steve’s, or walking the private beach as the sun sets. With stylish upgrades and cozy vibes, this 2-suite retreat, sleeping 8, is where relaxation meets adventure. Ready to escape to paradise? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Unbeatable Gulf Views – Start your mornings with breathtaking sunrises and end your evenings with stunning sunsets, all from your private balcony or the comfort of your primary suite. The ocean is always in sight.Lagoon-Style Pool with Waterfall and Hot Tub – A tropical oasis awaits! Relax by the serene community pool, soak in the hot tub, or let the soothing waterfall transport you to paradise.Beachfront Dining at Crabby Steve’s Beach Bar & Grill – Savor fresh, local flavors with your toes in the sand and the sound of waves in the background. Dining here is a true coastal escape.Updated Interiors with Modern Finishes and High Ceilings – Enjoy the perfect blend of luxury and comfort with sleek, modern updates and airy spaces that make every moment feel sophisticated and inviting.Sleeps up to 8 with 2 Spacious Bedrooms, Including Custom Bunk Options – Roomy enough for family and friends, with stylish custom bunk beds the kids will love and plenty of space for everyone to unwind.Private Beach Access in a Gated Resort – Your exclusive slice of paradise is just steps away, providing uninterrupted relaxation and privacy in a secure and tranquil setting.Close to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Both Within Walking Distance – Immerse yourself in the charm of nearby coastal villages, where boutique shops, fine dining, and lively culture are just a short stroll away.*** LIVING AREA ***The open-concept living area is a bright, sophisticated retreat, perfectly crafted for relaxing with family or friends. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking Gulf views, flooding the space with natural light. Luxurious, cozy furnishings blend seamlessly with sleek, modern accents, creating the ultimate space to unwind and connect in style.Spacious open floor plan filled with natural light and stunning Gulf viewsPlush, comfortable seating for everyone, complete with a large flat-screen TV for entertainmentStep onto your private balcony featuring cozy outdoor seating and a dining table for 4, perfect for enjoying meals with a view*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen is designed for both culinary adventures and cozy takeout nights with a stunning view. Featuring sleek stainless steel appliances and thoughtful touches like a convenient mini-fridge, it offers the perfect blend of functionality and style to elevate your experience.Contemporary kitchen equipped with premium stainless steel appliances for a seamless cooking experienceChic island seating for 3 paired with a spacious dining table for 6, ideal for hosting unforgettable gatheringsBreathtaking Gulf-facing views that turn every meal into a memorable occasionConvenient in-unit washer and dryer for easy laundry care*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each bedroom is thoughtfully crafted for ultimate comfort, featuring luxurious bedding, premium linens, and calming, elegant décor. The bathrooms offer a modern, spa-inspired retreat with rainfall showers, ample countertop space, and all the essentials for a rejuvenating experience.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and oversized soaking tub.Bunk Room: 2 Twin Over Queen Bunk Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort elevates your vacation experience with outstanding amenities designed to delight every guest. Indulge in beachside dining with stunning ocean views, unwind in the expansive community pool, and discover a destination where relaxation and luxury come together perfectly.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***High Pointe Resort on 30A puts you at the heart of it all! Take a leisurely stroll to the charming Rosemary Beach or the stunning Alys Beach, where you can discover boutique shops, delicious dining options, and unforgettable experiences.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 204330
